name: sheleg-design-skill
description: SHELEG Design — a motion + systems methodology for cinematic, scroll-driven, particle-backed landing pages, a motion doctrine that decides whether to animate before it decides how, and twenty-nine pluggable visual style packs covering landing, product UI, presentation decks, consumer health, developer tools, data infrastructure, results reporting and data consoles, packaged as an agent skill.

plugins.name: sheleg-design
plugins.description: One scroll clock drives many cheap, layered, independently-degradable responses (WebGL particle field, 2D fallback, parallax, scrubbed instruments, progress rail) so a landing page reads as a single precision instrument — plus twenty-nine pluggable style packs: instrument-console, editorial-luxury, workbench, briefing-room, atrium, orchard, field-notes, cyclorama, showroom, blueprint, prism, maquette, scoreboard, datasheet, manpage, pigeonhole, roster, ora, tenor, paperclip, ledger, router, daylight, notation, almanac, vitrine, proscenium, bulletin. Skill + architecture reference + motion doctrine + Figma and Claude Design bridges + /sheleg-design command, and awning (a white forecourt where the accent is black and no hue reaches the chrome at all, a pill whose radius is a declared component token, one variable grotesque at 420/550 with no 700, and a single three-layer shadow, for commerce and platform front doors).
